title: Launch, choose a workspace, quit with sessions kept, relaunch and restore its terminal and browser tabs
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab
the tag's daemon keeps running while the app quits, so the sessions are kept

steps.note: a second workspace below the launch's, its first tab a terminal; a socket run files it without showing it
a focus action: the window shows the workspace new-workspace made
a WebKit tab on the New Tab page after the workspace's terminal (offline, no URL); a script run opens it unselected
9 is the last tab of the focused pane: the browser tab is selected when the app quits

expect.noReceiptReason: a relaunch runs no action; the restored windows, workspaces and tabs are its result

steps.note: the runner quits the app it started with Quit and Keep Sessions (quitKeepSessions), so the daemon keeps the sessions, then launches the same tag on the same state root
the chosen workspace comes back selected, with the public id it had before the quit
the launch's workspace and new-workspace's, each exactly once
the launch's terminal, new-workspace's terminal and open-browser's tab: none is lost, none comes back twice
the browser tab selected at the quit is the selected tab again

invariants: after the relaunch the window shows the workspace new-workspace made, with the same public id (ws_...) and the name restore fixture
the session has the same two workspaces and three tabs before and after the relaunch: none is lost and none comes back twice
the selected tab after the relaunch is the browser tab that was selected at the quit, and the terminal tabs keep their terminals (the daemon kept them)
the topology, sidebar and tabs facets of the restored snapshot equal those of kept, except the values the relaunch itself changes (window and process ids)
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
no orphan process, socket or duplicate tab is left at teardown (I6, I15)
no child process exits unexpectedly (I17): the quit ends the app only
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: a browser tab on a loaded page: the case runs offline, and the loopback web fixture (fixture.web, p15-oracle-222) is not in the app driver yet
the terminal's scrollback after the relaunch: the terminals facet hashes only the last 24 lines
